news.title: Accelerating New Power Plants Depends on Better Data
news.summary_en: The United States is embarking on a vast build-out of its electric system. Transparent cost data would help regulators pinpoint avoidable delays, help developers assess risk, and help communities judge the value they are being asked to host.

news.title: Achieving AI Model Weight Security Level 3 (SL3)
news.summary_en: RAND proposes Security Level 3 (SL3), a framework of 262 security controls to protect artificial intelligence (AI) model weights against organized cybercrime and insider threats, achievable within six to 12 months.

news.title: Federal Revenue When AI Replaces Labor: An Examination of Economic Scenarios with Highly Capable Artificial Intelligence
news.summary_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) replacing human labor could sharply reduce U.S. federal revenue, especially if workers are not reemployed or AI is cheap. Proactive fiscal policy is needed to manage these risks.

news.title: The Cyclospora Outbreak Was a Warning: Q&A with Saskia Popescu
news.summary_en: Saskia Popescu is an epidemiologist by training and a policy researcher at RAND. In this Q&A, she discusses what the United States can do to prepare for future outbreaks like Cyclospora and other biological threats.
